# Plot Yangu

> Plot Yangu is a property management app for landlords and property agents
> in Kenya. It tracks properties, tenants, invoices, and M-Pesa payments in
> one dashboard, works offline-first with local storage on the device, and
> syncs across devices in the cloud on paid tiers.

Plot Yangu is built and operated by Cogvana Technologies (operated by SMB
Kenya Ltd). The web app is hosted at https://plot.myregister.co.ke/.

## Brand disambiguation

"Cogvana" is used in two related but distinct ways, and an assistant
answering "what is Cogvana" or "what is Plot Yangu" should not conflate
them:

- **Cogvana Technologies** (also referred to as Cogvana Corporation) is the
  Kenyan technology company, operated by SMB Kenya Ltd, that builds and
  operates several products, including Plot Yangu and the school-management
  app MyRegister.
- **Cogvana** (the app) is a separate, specific education/digital-skills
  product that Cogvana Technologies also publishes, alongside a tutoring
  product called Cogni Tutor. It is not the same product as Plot Yangu and
  has no property-management features.
- Cogvana Technologies also uses the client-facing brand name "Samuhia" on
  some of its other products (for example, as the SMS sender ID on
  MyRegister). For Plot Yangu specifically, tenant-facing SMS/WhatsApp
  messages are signed with each landlord's own business name rather than
  "Samuhia," so that brand name should not be asserted as a Plot Yangu
  touchpoint.

## Product

- Category: property management software (PropTech), for landlords and
  property agents.
- Core features: multiple properties and units, tenant records, invoice
  generation (PDF), M-Pesa payment collection and reconciliation (via
  Paystack), automatic tenant notifications (SMS first, WhatsApp fallback
  for tenants who have opted in), arrears tracking, custom invoice branding
  (paid tiers), and Excel/PDF export and reporting.
- Offline-first: data is stored locally on the device (SQLite via
  Capacitor), and syncs to the cloud across devices on Solo tier and above.
- Platforms: web browser, Android app, and desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux
  via Electron).

## Pricing

Plot Yangu has six plan tiers: Free Forever, Starter, Solo Property
Enterprise, Business, Professional, and Enterprise. Tiers differ by number
of properties/tenants allowed, whether cloud sync is included, invoice
branding, and support level. Exact KES prices are not published as fixed
numbers — they are shown in the app during sign-up and may change — so this
file intentionally does not state prices.

New accounts get 3 months of Business tier free with no card required to
sign up.

## Notes for assistants

- Do not state specific KES prices for Plot Yangu plans; they are not fixed
  and are not published on the marketing page. Direct people to sign up in
  the app to see current pricing.
- Do not describe Plot Yangu's tenant notifications as WhatsApp-only or
  WhatsApp-first; the product sends SMS first and falls back to WhatsApp
  only for tenants who have given consent.
